5f06c2e0b8eb19b91571.en: Sharing means giving out equally, one at a time.
5f06c2e0b8eb19b91571.id: Membagi rata (sharing) berarti memberi sama banyak, satu per satu.

49a63170fa46f9233fdc.en: Grouping means making groups of the same size.
49a63170fa46f9233fdc.id: Mengelompokkan (grouping) berarti membuat kelompok yang sama besar.

4821c43c883c365fea48.en: 10 shared into 2 equal groups is 5 in each. 10 ÷ 2 = 5.
4821c43c883c365fea48.id: 10 dibagi menjadi 2 kelompok sama besar, masing-masing berisi 5. 10 ÷ 2 = 5.

eb5def252dbab687915e.en: Share 12 one at a time into 3 groups. Each group gets 4, since 3 × 4 = 12.
eb5def252dbab687915e.id: Bagikan 12 satu per satu ke 3 kelompok. Setiap kelompok mendapat 4, karena 3 × 4 = 12.
